snippet.title: Friday Night  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game now!

Steam Page:https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537620/Friday_Night/

Friday Night is a first-person horror game that uses voice recognition to fully immerse players inside the game.

You play as Michael Maxwell, an investigator whose family was brutally murdered under mysterious circumstances in their mansion. Film your experience in your camcorder, communicate with the spirit using your microphone and uncover the truth of the Maxwell tragedy.

Made by Solo Developer
